title: TeleOCR (NaviDC-OCR)
runtimeNote: stock llama.cpp cannot load this GGUF. The model sets head_dim=128 while hidden_size/num_heads=64, and the qwen2vl loader assumes the two are equal; the fix is not upstream, so no release will do. Run it from External mode with a llama.cpp built with the qwen2vl QK-norm patch (PATCHES.md in the GGUF repository).

launch.name: ctx-size
launch.description: Model context window in tokens (prompt + image + output); 16384 is what the reference pipeline uses.

launch.name: n-predict
launch.description: Maximum tokens to generate per completion.

launch.name: cache-type-k
launch.description: KV cache data type for K. Same value in both roles on purpose: a differing layer would make the runtime reload the model when the task changes.

launch.name: cache-type-v
launch.description: KV cache data type for V. Same value in both roles on purpose: a differing layer would make the runtime reload the model when the task changes.

request.name: repeat_penalty
request.description: Penalty for repeating tokens; 1.0 disables it.

request.name: presence_penalty
request.description: Penalty for tokens already present in the prompt; 0 disables it.

request.name: frequency_penalty
request.description: Penalty proportional to token frequency; 0 disables it.

request.name: stream
request.description: Stream tokens as they arrive; false gives the parser one complete response.

request.name: cache_prompt
request.description: Cache the prompt (image embeddings, system message) between requests.

blockPrompts.text:
Please output the text content from the image. The candidate below is the OCR reading of the same crop: check it against the image and answer in the protocol from the system message.
Output format after FIX: plain text.

Check characters, numbers, punctuation, capitalization, and reading order.
Preserve the original language, spelling, and paragraph structure.
Correct OCR errors, not the author's wording.
Do not reflow lines or normalize typography when the candidate is equivalent.
blockPrompts.title:
Please output the text content from the image. The candidate below is the OCR reading of the same crop: check it against the image and answer in the protocol from the system message.
Output format after FIX: plain text.

Check letters, numbers, capitalization, punctuation, and reading order.
Preserve the original language, spelling, and heading level.
Correct OCR errors, not the author's wording.
Do not merge, split, or reorder words when the candidate is equivalent.
blockPrompts.table:
This is the image of a table. The candidate below is the OCR reading of the same crop: check the cells against the image and answer in the protocol from the system message.
Output format after FIX: HTML table with LaTeX inside cells where needed. Not OTSL.

Compare cells by their row and column positions.
Check every number, decimal point, sign, arrow, label, and superscript.
Check row order, column order, empty cells, rowspan, and colspan.
Do not calculate, round, reorder, fill blank cells, or infer missing values.
blockPrompts.formula:
Please write out the expression of the formula in the image using LaTeX format. The candidate below is the OCR reading of the same crop: check it against the image and answer in the protocol from the system message.
Output format after FIX: LaTeX.

Check every symbol, subscript, superscript, fraction, radical,
operator, bracket, accent, and equation number against the image.
Do not simplify expressions or replace them with familiar formulas.
Do not change spacing or LaTeX style unless needed to fix an error.
blockPrompts.equation:

Output format after FIX: LaTeX.

Check every symbol, subscript, superscript, fraction, radical,
operator, bracket, accent, and equation number against the image.
Do not simplify expressions or replace them with familiar formulas.

blockPrompts.code:
The image contains a code snippet. The candidate below is the OCR reading of the same crop: check it against the code in the image and answer in the protocol from the system message.
Output format after FIX: plain text preserving the code layout.

Check identifiers, keywords, strings, numbers, punctuation, and indentation.
Preserve the code structure, line breaks, and visible formatting.
Do not fix, reformat, or complete the code.
